metadata.case_name: CHENG YUK LIN v. UNIPRO LTD T/A BLUE SKY BALLROOM

plaintiff.occupation_before: waitress at the defendant's nightclub/karaoke in Yaumatei

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of the lower back
source: He found that it was likely she had sustained a soft tissue injury of the lower back.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: signs that suggested a condition called tethered spinal cord syndrome
source: There were signs that suggested a condition called tethered spinal cord syndrome.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of spinal cord at abdomen, lower back or pelvis level, unspecified

manifestations.description: complained of pain on both sides of her back after walking for half an hour
experienced pain after sitting or standing for half an hour
could only carry weights up to 5 kg
felt pain in her back with changes in the weather
had not complained of walking up stairs; nor of morning pain; nor complained of radiating symptoms to her lower limbs
straight leg raising (SLR) test was within the normal range
range of motion in flexion and extension was within the normal range
muscle power of both lower limbs were found to be within normal range

treatments_received: hospitalized at the Queen Elizabeth Hospital
physiotherapy (out-patient treatment at orthopaedic clinic until about July 1996)
treated with a further course of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs
treated by a chiropractor for lower back pain
physiotherapy treatment at Prince of Wales Hospital about 29 times

losses.description: Loss of earnings (past) $140,504.85 and Loss of future earnings (post-assessment) $82,173.96; plaintiff suffered a 5% loss of earning capacity as found by Dr Chiang

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: some reduction in capacity on occasions when handling heavy objects is required

comparable_cases.case_name: Lai Ching v Wong Chiu Kwai (t/a Wing Lai)
comparable_cases.injury_description: prolapsed disc at the L4-5 level with compression of the nerve root; there was a finding of 24% total impairment of the whole man, and a 35% loss of earning capacity
